title: Localized tensor comparison square under change of K-flat representative
statement: Let $R,A,B,C$ be commutative rings in one universe, let $A$ and $B$ be $R$-algebras, and let $C$ be an $E=A\otimes_R B$-algebra. Fix derived categories of $R$-, $A$- and $B$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $F$ for termwise extension of scalars from $A$ to $C$. Let $Q$ be a K-flat $A$-complex [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], $N$ any $C$-complex, and $t:F(Q)\to N$ a chain map. Let $U,V$ be K-flat $A$-complexes, with $Q_A(U)\simeq Q_A(V)$ in the derived category. Choose base-derived tensor cohomology models $m_U,m_V$ [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] for $U\otimes_A Q$ and $V\otimes_A Q$. For each $i\in\mathbf Z$, there exist $C$-linear isomorphisms $e:C\otimes_E m_U.cohomology_i\simeq C\otimes_E m_V.cohomology_i$ and $d:H^i(F(U)\otimes_C N)\simeq H^i(F(V)\otimes_C N)$ such that $\alpha_U d=e\alpha_V$. Here $\alpha_P=m_P.localizedComparison_i$ followed by $H^i(\mu^{-1}_{P,Q};F(P)\otimes t)$, and $\mu$ is the canonical monoidal scalar-extension tensorator. Neither comparison is assumed invertible; no flatness of $C$ or $N$ is assumed.

proof.text: Convert the acyclic-test K-flat hypotheses to the source-library MorphismProperty.kFlat predicate using HomotopyCategory.kFlat_quotient_obj_iff, kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic, and the braiding. The reverse conversion takes the second conjunct. No new notion of K-flatness is introduced.

For a quasi-isomorphism s:P→G of K-flat A-complexes, tensoring s with the K-flat Q preserves quasi-isomorphisms. Apply the localized base-derived model quasi-isomorphism comparison to s tensor Q and extend its source isomorphism to C.

Termwise extension F preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes: apply mixedTensor_kFlat_quasiIso with the C-unit in degree zero. mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso and the termwise left-unitor natural isomorphism identify this tensor map with F.map s. Extension preserves K-flatness by acyclic_mapBifunctor_extendScalars_of_kFlat. Hence the existing generic MorphismProperty.whiskerRight_of_kFlat makes F.map s tensor N a quasi-isomorphism, even for arbitrary N.

Whisker exchange and OplaxMonoidal.δ_natural_left give the chain equality (μ.inv; F(P) tensor t); (F(s) tensor N) = F(s tensor Q); (μ.inv; F(G) tensor t). Apply homology, reassociate, and substitute the model comparison square from step 2. This constructs the source and target isomorphisms and their comparison square for a single quasi-isomorphism.

Use Mathlib DerivedCategory.right_fac to represent the given derived isomorphism by a roof U←L→V. Q reflects quasi-isomorphisms and the right-leg image equals the left-leg image followed by eUV, so both legs are quasi-isomorphisms. Use the proved source-library ModuleCat.hasFunctorialFlatResolution and the reduced resolution functor, its quasi-isomorphic augmentation, and LeftResolution.kFlat_resolutionFunctor_obj to replace L by a K-flat L′. Composing its augmentation with either leg gives quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat objects. The proof uses a base-derived model of L′ tensor Q only locally inside an existential proposition; it defines no data from an arbitrary witness.

Apply the single-leg square to the two refined roof legs. If they give αL;dL=eL;αU and αL;dR=eR;αV, take e=eL⁻¹;eR and d=dL⁻¹;dR. Cancel eL and dL and reassociate to get αU;d=e;αV. This is the asserted square.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_localizedTensorComparison_representative_square
    (hQ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (U V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hU : ∀ W : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, W.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor W U (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (hV : ∀ W : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, W.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor W V (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (eUV : DerivedCategory.Q.obj U ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj V)
    (mU : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U ⊗ Q) C)
    (mV : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (V ⊗ Q) C) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    ∃ (e : (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)).obj (mU.cohomology i) ≅
        (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)).obj (mV.cohomology i))
      (d : (F.obj U ⊗ N).homology i ≅ (F.obj V ⊗ N).homology i),
      (mU.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U Q).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t)) i) ≫ d.hom =
      e.hom ≫ mV.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F V Q).inv ≫ (F.obj V ◁ t)) i
